name: apple-tv-agent
description: Control and observe configured Apple TVs through a LAN-local bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Apple TV through a local bridge.
interface.longDescription: Discover, control, and optionally observe configured Apple TVs through a local, agent-neutral bridge. Pairing material stays on the bridge.
defaultPrompt: Show me the configured Apple TVs and their current status.
Prepare the requested Apple TV state and verify the result.
